Lina V: Heads up: scheduled control-plane peering failover + synthetic load run on 2025-09-12 03:00-05:00 UTC. This targets peering-proxy clusters between eu-west-1 <-> us-west-2. Expect short control-plane errors; data-plane inference should stay healthy.
Theo R: Any customer-facing impact?
Lina V: Not expected for inference. Control-plane ops (deploys, scale API, config updates) may see transient 502/503s. We'll relax deploy p99 SLO during the window and recommend clients retry with backoff for control-plane calls.
SRE Oncall: Canary plan? rollback thresholds?
Lina V: Canary at 02:30 UTC on proxy-eu-a (1% control-plane traffic). Ramp to 15% at 02:45, full flip at 03:00. Rollback immediately if control-plane error-rate > 2x baseline for 3 consecutive minutes or BGP flaps exceed threshold. Rollback action: revert route announcements and re-establish previous peering within 60s.
InfraBot: Maintenance job queued: job-id peering-fail-20250912. Details: https://redwood.internal/ops/peering-fail-20250912
Product Ops: We'll broadcast a short advisory to customers in EU/NA with the window + mitigation steps.
Lina V: During the window we'll run synth-load generator synth-v3 to simulate cross-region chatter; services can opt out by setting header `X-Rw-NoSynth: true` or tagging service `synth-optout`.
QA Eng: SLO changes?
Lina V: Temporary SLO tweak: control-plane deploy latency p99 750ms -> 1500ms for 03:00-04:00 UTC only. No change to inference p99 SLOs or customer SLAs.
Theo R: Paging list?
SRE Oncall: Page SRE Oncall + Lina V + Theo R. Runbook contact list has infra/runtime leads.
Lina V: Preflight at 02:00 UTC; join if you can. We'll post live updates in this thread and a short postmortem within 48h if anything unexpected occurs.
InfraBot: Reminder scheduled: 60 minutes until peering-fail-20250912 starts (2025-09-12T02:00:00Z).
